editorial:
You follow Wyman, a smart literature grad who writes cheap erotic stories, as he somehow lands in a Japanese adult video and becomes a porn star. The movie mixes silly comedy with wild behind-the-scenes moments, so you get laughs, awkward situations, and a fast-moving story that keeps surprising you. The tone is playful and cheeky, with plenty of energy and a cast that leans into the absurd setup without taking it too seriously.

The pacing stays quick, and the jokes land often enough to keep you smiling, even when the story gets messy. Some scenes feel over the top, and the humor may not work for everyone, but the movie knows what it is and has fun with it. If you enjoy bold comedies with an unusual premise, this is a good pick.
